organisation.title: About your organisation
organisation.why: Your answers describe your organisation for everyone who uses this workspace.
organisation.name: Organisation name
organisation.nameHint: The name people know your organisation by.
organisation.descriptionHint: A sentence or two in your own words, such as what you offer and to whom.
organisation.headcount: Roughly how many people work here?
organisation.headcountHint: Include employees and regular contractors. An estimate is fine.

sites.title: Where you work
sites.why: Sites are the places your organisation works from. Records can then say where information and equipment are kept.
sites.sitesHint: Add each office, branch or other location. You need at least one.
sites.departmentsHint: Optional — add teams if some people should only see their own area.

frameworks.title: Frameworks you follow
frameworks.why: Frameworks are the standards and laws your security is measured against. Controls and reports are organised around the ones you choose.
frameworks.hint: Not sure? GDPR applies to most organisations that handle personal data of people in the EU. You can change this later.
frameworks.none: No frameworks are available yet, because the control library has not been loaded. Ask whoever runs this workspace to load it.

suggest.intro: The AI assistant can suggest frameworks from your organisation's answers. Nothing is chosen for you: check each suggestion yourself.
suggest.arrived: {count, plural, one {# framework suggested.} other {# frameworks suggested.}} Check each one before you save.
suggest.noneNew: No new frameworks to suggest from your answers.
suggest.unavailable: The AI assistant isn't available right now. You can choose your frameworks yourself.
suggest.profileFirst: Save your organisation's profile first, so there are answers to suggest from.
suggest.failed: Suggestions couldn't be fetched. Try again, or choose your frameworks yourself.

riskAppetite.title: How much risk you accept
riskAppetite.why: Your risk appetite decides which risks you can accept as they are and which need a closer look. You can change it later.

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.description: Accept only small risks. Most risks get a closer look.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Accept everyday risks and look closely at serious ones.

bold.label: Bold
bold.description: Accept more risk to move faster. Only the most serious risks get a closer look.

current.label: Keep your current setting
current.description: The setting saved earlier for this workspace.

riskAppetite.rule: Above appetite when a risk scores more than {threshold}.
riskAppetite.caption: Each square is one combination of likelihood and impact. A risk’s score is its likelihood multiplied by its impact.
riskAppetite.scrollHint: Swipe sideways to see every likelihood.

people.title: Who does what
people.why: Roles decide what each person can see and do. Give each person only what their work needs.
people.signInNote: People appear here after they sign in for the first time.

dialog.title: Roles for {name}
dialog.description: Choose where the roles apply, then what {name} does there.

review.title: Check and finish
review.why: Here is everything you have told us. Change anything that is not right, then finish setup.
review.headcount: About {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
review.appetite: {preset}. Above appetite when a risk scores more than {threshold}.
review.missingHint: Answer these steps, then you can finish setup:
review.ready: Every step has an answer. You can finish setup now.
review.finished: Setup was finished on {date}. You can still change any answer: use Edit on the step.

errors.summary: Some answers need another look. Each one has a note next to it.
errors.name: Enter your organisation's name in plain text, up to 200 characters.
errors.description: Describe what your organisation does, up to 2,000 characters.
errors.headcount: Enter a whole number of people, for example 40.
errors.siteName: Enter a name for this site in plain text, up to 120 characters.
errors.siteNameDuplicate: Another site already has this name. Give each site its own name.
errors.country: Choose the country this site is in.
errors.departmentName: Enter a name for this department in plain text, up to 120 characters.
errors.departmentNameDuplicate: Another department already has this name. Give each department its own name.
errors.siteInUse: This site is still linked to other records, so it can't be removed. We've put it back, and nothing was saved.
errors.departmentInUse: This department is still linked to other records, so it can't be removed. We've put it back, and nothing was saved.
errors.staleSite: Someone else changed this list while you were editing. Reload the page to see the latest version.
errors.forbidden: Your role doesn't allow changing these answers. Ask an administrator.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't save your answers just now. Your answers are still here, so please try again in a minute.
errors.notAccepted: We couldn't accept these answers. Please check them and try again.
errors.frameworks: Choose at least one framework your organisation follows.
errors.lastAdministrator: Someone must stay an administrator of the whole organisation. Give this role to another person first.
errors.duplicateRoleAssignment: This person already has one of these roles here. Reload the page to see their current roles.
errors.scope: Choose the site or department these roles apply to.
errors.setupIncomplete: Some steps still need an answer before you can finish.
errors.changed: Someone else changed this while you were working. Reload the page to see the latest version.

reviewInterval.title: How often risks are reviewed
reviewInterval.label: Review risks every N months
reviewInterval.hint: Approved and treated risks come back to their owner for review after this long.

errors.months: Enter a whole number of months from 1 to 36, for example 12.
errors.forbidden: Your role doesn't allow changing this. Ask an administrator.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't save this just now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.notAccepted: We couldn't accept this answer. Finish the earlier steps, then try again.

load.description: Replace everything with a year of sample activity for Isarwerk Finanz AG (sample).

reset.description: Delete all data and settings and return to a fresh install.

deletes: Settings, including the AI provider key
dialog.after: You will be signed out, and so will everyone else. This cannot be undone.

label.name: Type the organisation name to confirm

dialog.hintReset: No organisation is set up yet, so type RESET in capital letters.

errors.confirmationMismatch: That text doesn't match. Type it exactly as shown, then try again.
errors.recentAuth: For safety, please sign in again to confirm it is you. Then try once more.
errors.forbidden: Your role doesn't allow this. Ask an administrator.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't do this just now. Nothing was confirmed as changed, so please check and try again in a minute.

administrator.label: Administrator
administrator.description: Sets up the workspace and decides who does what.

ciso.label: Security lead
ciso.description: Leads security: reviews risks, controls and their mappings.

risk_owner.label: Risk owner
risk_owner.description: Looks after the risks in their area.

contributor.label: Contributor
contributor.description: Reports concerns and provides evidence when asked.

auditor.label: Auditor
auditor.description: Reads everything, including history, but changes nothing.
